fixes.fix_code: <meta name="description" content="LaunchPad helps startups ship their MVP in 48 hours. Get expert development, rapid prototyping, and launch-ready products fast. Start building today!">
fixes.fix_explanation: A meta description helps search engines understand your page and improves click-through rates from search results.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the viewport meta tag

fixes.fix_explanation: The canonical tag prevents duplicate content issues by telling search engines the preferred URL for this page.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the title tag

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:title" content="LaunchPad — Ship Your MVP in 48 Hours">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:title tag controls how your page title appears when shared on social media platforms like Facebook and LinkedIn.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the canonical link tag

fixes.fix_code: <meta property="og:description" content="LaunchPad helps startups ship their MVP in 48 hours. Get expert development, rapid prototyping, and launch-ready products fast. Start building today!">
fixes.fix_explanation: The og:description tag provides the summary text that appears below your title when your page is shared on social media.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the og:title meta tag

fixes.fix_explanation: The og:image tag specifies the image that displays when your page is shared on social media, dramatically improving engagement.
fixes.fix_location: Inside the <head> tag, after the og:description meta tag

fixes.fix_explanation: A sitemap.xml file helps search engines discover and index all important pages on your website efficiently.
